title: 5.2 Logarithmic Functions and Their Graphs

icans: I can rewrite between logarithmic and exponential form.
I can evaluate logarithms and use their basic properties.
I can graph logarithmic functions and find their domains.

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Definition: y = logₐ x if and only if _______________.

blocks.stem:
a.  Write log₂ 8 = 3 and log₅(1/25) = −2 in exponential form.
b.  Write 4³ = 64 in logarithmic form.

Evaluate without a calculator.
a.  log₂ 32     b.  log₃ 1     c.  log₄ 2     d.  log(1/100)

notes: Properties: logₐ 1 = 0, logₐ a = 1, logₐ aˣ = x, and a^(logₐ x) = _______________.
Graph of y = logₐ x: x-intercept (1, 0), vertical asymptote _______________, domain x > 0.
Domain: the expression inside a logarithm must be _______________.

blocks.stem: Graph f(x) = log₃ x and g(x) = log₃(x − 2) + 1. Give each asymptote and x-intercept.
Find the domain and vertical asymptote of f(x) = log₄(x + 5).
